subject: How to plot dots with different sizes

messages.subject: How to plot dots with different sizes
parts:
Hello all, I would like to know how to plot trajectory trend lines with dots increasing in size, as in the example of Adams and Nistri 2010..
witch parameter should I change in the plotAllometry function?

messages.author: f16866fc42d43e64
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] How to plot dots with different sizes
parts:
Jayme, this is basic R-plotting, you need to change the cex general plotting parameter. For something like the example of Plethodon you would need to figure out a way (basic R scripting) to make cex proportional to e.g. log centroid size, or other parameter of interest. 

Antigoni
